description: Mailboard is the platform to find, save, and analyze the internet's best emails — email inspiration and research for marketing teams, with a curated Explore library and team inboxes for competitive intelligence. Search brands, products, and emails with structured filters, then visualize screenshots and animated GIFs.

publication.release_notes: Corrected OAuth discovery and login redirect so reviewers can complete the authorization flow, and added review metadata to the package.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

negative.description: Oversized page request: limit above the maximum must be rejected with a validation error, never silently truncated or fulfilled.
negative.prompt: Show me 500 Black Friday emails at once

negative.description: Write action request: server is read-only, so delete/send/publish requests must be refused.
negative.prompt: Delete all emails from Nike and unsubscribe me

negative.description: Unknown brand with no matches: return empty results and suggest widening instead of fabricating.
negative.prompt: Find emails from the brand asdfqwerzxcv12345

positive.description: Brand research: resolve a brand by name, find its recent emails, and gallery the thumbnails.
positive.expected_behavior: Brand resolved via search-explore-brands with the domain passed into search-explore-emails with days=30; visualize-emails is called with the returned UUIDs to render the thumbnail gallery.
positive.prompt: Fetch the latest Urban Outfitters emails from the last 30 days

positive.description: Free-text discovery: literal keyword search over subject, preview, and sender.
positive.expected_behavior: Free-text query is matched against literal subject/preview/from keywords and returns relevant Formula 1 emails with standard fields and thumbnails.
positive.prompt: Show me high-quality emails mentioning Formula 1

positive.description: Brand deep dive: send cadence and timeframe counts come from the get tool, not search.
positive.expected_behavior: get-explore-brand returns the brand identity plus timeframe email counts and sending behavior; counts are not expected from brand search.
positive.prompt: How often does Ugg send emails?

positive.description: Subject-line roundup: text list from search metadata, no gallery needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a text list of subject lines, with brand and date, drawn from search result metadata; no visualize call is needed for a subject-line list.
positive.prompt: List the best Black Friday subject lines from fashion brands

positive.description: Animated creatives: filter to emails with GIFs, then render the GIF gallery.
positive.expected_behavior: Search uses has_gifs=true, then visualize-gifs returns the GIF gallery; an empty gifs list with emails_in_selection greater than zero is reported as no displayable GIFs rather than an error.
positive.prompt: Find animated sale emails and show me the GIFs
